name: galaxyproject
description: Galaxy Project plugins for AI coding agents: the galaxy-mcp server plus curated Galaxy skills.

plugins.name: galaxy-mcp
plugins.description: Galaxy MCP server (galaxy-mcp via uvx) configured with your Galaxy URL and API key, plus the galaxy-connect setup skill.

plugins.name: galaxy-skills
plugins.description: Curated Galaxy skills for running analyses -- connection, MCP tool surface, collections, user-defined tools, reports, reproducibility. Mirrors the skills/ tree of galaxyproject/galaxy-skills.

plugins.name: galaxy-dev-skills
plugins.description: Galaxy development skills -- tool wrappers, Nextflow conversion, ToolShed revisions, track hubs, Hub posts. Mirrors the dev-skills/ tree of galaxyproject/galaxy-skills.

plugins.name: foundry-skills
plugins.description: Galaxy Workflow Foundry cast skills (paper/Nextflow/CWL to validated Galaxy workflows) mirrored from galaxyproject/foundry.
